GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Listening for details Conversational skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for details Conversational skills.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening for details Conversational skills.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening for details Conversational skills.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for details Conversational skills.

2. When practising Listening comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening comprehension.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening comprehension.

3. When practising Reading for comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading for comprehension.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading for comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading for comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for comprehension.

4. When practising Public speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Public speaking.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Public speaking.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Public speaking.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Public speaking.

5. When practising Intensive Reading Skimming, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Intensive Reading Skimming.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Intensive Reading Skimming.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Intensive Reading Skimming.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Intensive Reading Skimming.

6. When practising Reading comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading comprehension.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading comprehension.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading comprehension.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading comprehension.

7. When practising Listening for Information ● biased listening ● listening for comprehension ● con, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information ● biased listening ● listening for comprehension ● con.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information ● biased listening ● listening for comprehension ● con.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information ● biased listening ● listening for comprehension ● con.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information ● biased listening ● listening for comprehension ● con.

8. “Guten Tag” means: (1 mark)
   A. Good day / hello
   B. Please
   C. Thank you
   D. Good night

9. When practising Intensive reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Intensive reading.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Intensive reading.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Intensive reading.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Intensive reading.

10. When practising Extensive reading Scanning, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Extensive reading Scanning.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Extensive reading Scanning.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Extensive reading Scanning.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Extensive reading Scanning.

11. When practising Fluency Critical listening Tourist destinations and attractions, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Fluency Critical listening Tourist destinations and attractions.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Fluency Critical listening Tourist destinations and attractions.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Fluency Critical listening Tourist destinations and attractions.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Fluency Critical listening Tourist destinations and attractions.

12. German for “school” is: (1 mark)
   A. Buch
   B. Wasser
   C. Haus
   D. Schule

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Intensive Reading Skimming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Public speaking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Extensive reading Scanning and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for details Conversational skills.

2. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening comprehension.

3. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for comprehension.

4. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Public speaking.

5. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Intensive Reading Skimming.

6. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading comprehension.

7. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information ● biased listening ● listening for comprehension ● con.

8. A — Good day / hello

9. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Intensive reading.

10. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Extensive reading Scanning.

11. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Fluency Critical listening Tourist destinations and attractions.

12. D — Schule

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Intensive Reading Skimming; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Extensive reading Scanning; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Reading for comprehension; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
